content: # Nearest Airports. Find the 5 closest airports to the given latitude and longitude, irrespective of the radius of the reference point. Hence, a radius is not needed for this service. You can use the distance in the response to decide whether to present the user with more than one option or automatically choose the nearest. GET /references/airports/nearest/{latitude},{longitude} GET /references/airports/nearest/{latitude},{longitude}[?
